source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Radiator and Grille, p.13-10

procedures.title: Grille (Corvette): remove and install
steps: Remove the left and right parking lamps.
Remove the screws holding the left and right grilles and take the grilles out.
Remove the 4 screws holding the center grille assembly and take it out.
Installation: install the grilles and related parts in reverse order.
notes: See figure 11 in the manual for the grille assembly.
